the BMC is a good starting point to develop business models but is not sufficient to support the full range of business model design, evaluation, and development.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have extended the BMC to include a dynamic perspective.
the BMC is an excellent starting point for business model analysis and design.
the BMC is an ontology for business model design and evaluation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the BMC can be used to support the design and assessment of business models at three levels: novice, expert and master.
the BMC should be seen as a tool for the business model designer and not just a tool for the design of the business model itself.
the Business Model Canvas is not a static tool but a dynamic one, and we provide a framework for understanding its dynamic nature.
